description: Ministry of   Defence  -  Award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal  and Long Service Clap
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel. This falls under public service matters related to military service awards and recognition, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) covering public sector service conditions, benefits, and recognitions. While it mentions the President and Secretary of Defence, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or fit any other specialized category more specifically.
